Description: Brunswick is a historic coastal port city in Georgia's Golden Isles, serving as the mainland gateway to St. Simons Island and Jekyll Island. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, deep maritime and shrimping heritage, coastal water access, Walmart access, and affordable typical home values around $258,000. Tradeoffs include high Part I crime rates relative to the national average, hot humid summers, and no local Costco.
